title: Reject empty entries in legacy Skill lists
goal: Reject legacy Skill contracts whose comma-separated permissions or dependencies contain empty entries.
context: After malformed lines and duplicate fields were made fail-closed, the legacy parser still uses split's default empty-subsequence omission. Values such as `READ_WORKSPACE,,WRITE_WORKSPACE` silently lose the empty entry and appear valid.
forbidden_changes: Do not change the canonical Skill.md grammar or field names.
Do not silently drop empty permission or dependency entries.
Do not modify executor mapping, policy, UI, or provider behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Comma-separated lists preserve empty subsequences during validation.
Any empty permission or dependency entry throws SkillDefinitionError.malformed.
Valid existing legacy Skill contracts continue to parse.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If valid contracts fail, preserve existing trimming and required-field behavior while rejecting only empty list entries.
